source.snippet: Home cooks would like a free app that randomly suggests a dinner recipe when they cannot decide what to make.

problem_statement: Home cooks would like a free app that randomly suggests a dinner recipe when they cannot decide what to make.
notes: Weak commercial case: consumers expect this free, dozens of free apps exist, no willingness to pay, no clear paying buyer, ad-only model needs massive scale. Included as a NEGATIVE control — should stay well below 5.5.
